highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.147.0 previews the v4 engine update with variable fonts, animated WebP encoding, and new surface-draw sampling.
highlights_body: This preview moves the bundled renderer through Skia m147, adds zero-copy stream data access, and expands platform support. It begins the v4 breaking-change transition, including a Vulkan YCbCr type rename and changed equality support.

breaking.title: Vulkan YCbCr conversion info type renamed
breaking.body: GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo now uses GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo instead of GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo. Update references to the renamed type and replace uses of its removed equality interface and equality operators with explicit field comparisons where needed.

bullets.detail: The bundled Skia engine advances from m132 through m147, bringing upstream rendering fixes and improvements across supported platforms.

bullets.lead: Variable fonts and color font palettes
bullets.detail: SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp add variable-font support, while SKFont and SKTypeface gain color-palette selection and more robust variable-font handling.
New SKSurface.Draw and SKCanvas.DrawSurface overloads accept SKSamplingOptions, so callers can choose filtering and mipmap behavior for surface-to-surface draws.

bullets.lead: Animated WebP encoding and zero-copy stream data
bullets.detail: SKWebpEncoder can produce animated WebP files, and SKStream.GetData converts a seekable stream to SKData without an intermediate byte array.
HarfBuzzSharp adds an HBColor value type and fills in missing or inconsistently named binding wrappers.
Finalization no longer crashes when an SKPathBuilder is collected before an SKPath created from it.

bullets.lead: Android SKGLView survives MAUI tab changes
bullets.detail: SKGLView is reattached correctly after a MAUI TabBar view switch, preventing a blank rendering surface.

bullets.lead: New Linux Bionic and 64-bit Tizen native assets
bullets.detail: Android-hosted Linux is supported through linux-bionic assets, and Tizen gains x64 and arm64 native builds.
Libraries target versioned Apple TFMs while sample apps use unversioned TFMs, aligning the packages with current .NET SDK guidance.
Pre-.NET 8 Emscripten native runtime assets are no longer included in SkiaSharp WASM packages.
The release updates libexpat, libpng, zlib, FreeType, and libjpeg-turbo to newer upstream versions.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Skia milestone updates, variable-font support, the managed default-typeface fix, and the SKPath finalizer crash fix
contributor_summaries.4Darmygeometry: Linux Bionic native assets and C# 13 support for legacy target frameworks
contributor_summaries.SimonvBez: Fixed SKGLView rendering after MAUI TabBar tab switches on Android

preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 opened the v4 line with the Skia m132 through m147 engine updates, variable fonts, color font palettes, surface-draw sampling, Linux Bionic, and 64-bit Tizen support.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 added animated WebP encoding, zero-copy SKStream.GetData access, the SKPath finalizer fix, and Apple TFM alignment.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.3.1: Preview 3 added HBColor and missing HarfBuzz wrappers, removed pre-.NET 8 WASM runtime assets, and refreshed FreeType, zlib, and libjpeg-turbo.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp 8.3.1.6 includes variable-font and color-palette support, the HBColor value type, and additional binding wrappers.

v4.147.0-preview.1.1.headline: SkiaSharp 4.147.0 Preview 1 opens the v4 line with the Skia m147 engine update.
v4.147.0-preview.1.1.body: It adds variable fonts, color font palettes, surface-draw sampling controls, and new Linux Bionic and 64-bit Tizen native assets.

v4.147.0-preview.2.1.headline: SkiaSharp 4.147.0 Preview 2 adds animated WebP encoding and zero-copy stream data access.
v4.147.0-preview.2.1.body: It also fixes an SKPath finalizer ordering crash and aligns Apple target frameworks with current .NET SDK guidance.

v4.147.0-preview.3.1.headline: SkiaSharp 4.147.0 Preview 3 expands HarfBuzzSharp APIs and updates bundled dependencies.
v4.147.0-preview.3.1.body: It adds HBColor and missing HarfBuzz wrappers, requires .NET 8 or later for WASM runtime assets, and refreshes FreeType, zlib, and libjpeg-turbo.
